aiSummary: 今日聚焦国际政策领域。热点议题包括：US Strikes al；Scotland Proposes 3 New Visa；Two injured in North Memphis。本日共收录 10 条重要国际新闻。

articles.title: US Strikes al-Shabaab Weapons Warehouse in Northern Somalia
articles.description: US strikes al-Shabaab weapons warehouse in northern Somalia as AFRICOM intensifies operations targeting the militant group's weapons infrastructure.

articles.title: Scotland Proposes 3 New Visa Routes to Attract Foreign Fishermen, Farmers
articles.description: Scotland proposes three new visa routes for foreign workers, rural communities and graduates, but Westminster approval remains uncertain under UK immigration.

articles.title: Two injured in North Memphis shooting, MPD seeks suspect
articles.description: Memphis police are investigating a shooting in North Memphis that left two people injured Friday night.

articles.title: Museveni says ‘lies’ made Uganda stop buying fuel from Kenyan ‘brokers’
articles.description: Kenyan responded with a diplomatic touch, saying the ties between the two countries remain strong.

articles.title: Germany Working Holiday Programme: Full List of 12 Eligible Countries
articles.description: Germany’s Working Holiday Programme welcomes citizens from 12 countries for up to 12 months, with visa rules and application options varying by nationality.

articles.title: New Zealand Publishes 25 Countries and Territories Whose Citizens Can Transit Without a Visa
articles.description: New Zealand has listed 25 countries and territories whose citizens can transit through the country without a transit visa. The exemption is subject to conditions.

articles.title: Boca Raton woman blows out 105 candles surrounded by loved ones
articles.description: Katherine “Kay” Approbato celebrated a remarkable milestone, surrounded by family and friends as she marked her 105th birthday in Boca Raton.

articles.title: CNN Rejects White House Ban, Warns Trump Against 'Illegal Assault’ On Constitution
articles.description: The President announced the move on Truth Social, saying it was effective immediately and warning that other media organisations could face similar restrictions.

articles.title: Australia Lists 70 Countries Whose Citizens Can Transit Without a Visa in 2026
articles.description: Australia's 2026 Transit Without Visa policy lists 70 eligible nationalities, strict eight-hour rules and exclusions, with South Africa the only African entrant.
